name: React Fundamentals

questions.question: What is React?
options: A JavaScript library for building user interfaces

questions.question: Which hook is used to manage state in functional components?
Which method is called after a component is rendered for the first time?
What is the purpose of the useEffect hook?
options: To handle side effects in functional components

questions.question: How do you pass data from parent to child component?
What is the Virtual DOM?
options: A lightweight copy of the actual DOM

questions.question: Which of the following is used for routing in React?
What is the key prop used for in lists?
options: Helping React identify which items have changed

questions.question: What does React.Fragment do?
options: Groups multiple elements without adding extra nodes to the DOM
